market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $100 and bond yield spike create headwinds for equities. Bessent credibility damage limits Fed flexibility. Expect volatility in energy, rates, and trade-sensitive sectors. Gold and defensive assets outperform. 1-3 month risk of further oil spike if Iran conflict escalates.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on AI infrastructure (copper, data centers, semiconductors) and energy transition. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, African export bans) creates structural supply chain shifts. Consumer pressure may moderate as rates stabilize. 6-12 month: inflation cools if oil normalizes; equity recovery likely post-rate peak.
